purpose: Dedicated entry illustrations following the owner's rejection of reusing the format-selection posters.

requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original square illustration for the FIND AND PLAY entry card in Beat my track, a mature racing game. Create an entirely new scene, not a race-grid or front-facing car pack. A single believable fictional dark petrol-blue compact rally hatchback, no manufacturer badges, viewed from an elevated rear three-quarter angle as it takes a sweeping bend into a welcoming pine-forest race circuit at golden morning light. A small checkered trackside pennant and two distant direction markers suggest finding the next race. The curving asphalt and the one car are the clear central focal point, balanced within the middle 70 percent so a square image can crop to a menu card. Illustrated ink outlines, restrained cel-shaded painted forms, believable body proportions, matte natural materials, subtle weathering, premium motorsport editorial illustration. Muted deep pine greens, warm ochre sunlight, slate asphalt and small cream highlights; clear dark-to-light shapes readable at thumbnail scale. Rich composition without clutter. No typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no UI. Do not depict a night industrial arena, multiple rival cars, a starting-grid duel, or the existing cream/red front-facing racing posters. Native captions are added separately below the image.
requests.output_hint:
Generated images are saved to C:\Users\ville\.codex\generated_images\01a169e0-162c-7fe1-93ce-778c30d112af as C:\Users\ville\.codex\generated_images\01a169e0-162c-7fe1-93ce-778c30d112af\exec-b8c877ed-9090-439b-bcd8-d8a336eef49b.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.

requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original square illustration for CREATE A CHALLENGE entry card in Beat my track, a mature racing game. Create an entirely new race-organizer still life inside a refined working pit garage. Elevated three-quarter view of a dark blue steel workbench: three thick unlettered route-selection cards carry distinct clean ivory circuit-outline drawings, an analog mechanical stopwatch with no readable numerals, a pair of car keys, and a neatly folded small checkered flag. The route cards and stopwatch form the main central focal group, readable in the middle 70 percent after square or landscape cropping. In the upper background, one real full-size fictional burgundy compact hatchback is parked in the open garage, seen quietly from the side/rear; it is secondary and proportionately believable. Convey planning a competition and inviting rivals, with a different subject and composition from driving/racing artwork. Premium inked cel-shaded motorsport editorial illustration, crisp hand-painted material detail, mature restrained realism, matte steel and paper, warm garage task light against charcoal/navy shadows, small warm amber highlights. No people, no hands, no model/toy cars, no front-facing duel, no starting pack. No typography, no letters, no readable numbers, no brand badges, no logos, no watermark, no UI. Native captions are added below the image.
